description.text:
Barry's is Los Angeles' original indoor boutique bootcamp. Based around the simple idea of shocking your body with a combination of strength and cardiovascular exercises, enhanced by a night-club sound system and red lighting, clients often burn over 1,000 calories during a one hour class.

Our workouts include interval cardiovascular routines on Woodway treadmills and strength training utilising free weights. Muscle groups, intervals and workout segments vary to keep you guessing, and our trainers are the best in the business at helping you maximise your potential and ensuring every class feels new, fun and exciting.

Switch the board room for the Red Room and get your colleagues together for a team workout. Drop us an email marketinguk@barrysbootcamp.com to find out more about Sweatworking and corporate rates.

You won't experience a workout like this anywhere else.

Location: Crossrail Place
